records.title: Danh mục 14 Workshop — AI20K Cohort III
records.text: Workshop 1: Kick-off — Chia nhóm, chọn đề, khởi tạo repo; Workshop 2: Problem → MVP Canvas; Workshop 3: PM & team cowork — Soft skills, rules, xử lý xung đột; Workshop 4: Vibe coding 101 — By team; Workshop 5: AI Product Design — UX patterns & prototyping; Workshop 6: Tư duy Product — Cho người làm sản phẩm; Workshop 7: First Working Agent — LLM + tool calling; Workshop 8: RAG Pipeline — Ingestion, chunking, retrieval; Workshop 9: Multi-Step Agent — Plan → execute → validate; Workshop 10: MCP & Multi-Agent — Protocol & orchestration; Workshop 11: Optimize & Evaluate — Quality, latency, cost; Workshop 12: Guardrails & Reliability — Safety & error handling; Workshop 13: Go Live — CI/CD, cloud deploy, observability; Workshop 14: The Pitch — Product narrative & investor demo
